description: Guides levothyroxine (L-T4) dosing and monitoring in adults with central hypothyroidism (CH) from pituitary or hypothalamic disease, targeting serum free T4 in the mid to upper half of the reference range at about 1.6 μg/kg/d and adjusting with fT4, not TSH. Trigger phrases: "central hypothyroidism", "secondary hypothyroidism levothyroxine dose", "hypopituitarism fT4 target", "TSH undetectable on levothyroxine", "starting GH or estrogen in CH".
